amendment_reason: Policy v2 correctly separated scientific state from runtime/resource observations, but it equality-gated the mandatory run_label even though runs 3 and 4 were required to have distinct labels. Historical scope validators also conflated an unchanged historical evidence tree with a repository containing additive, separately named future-gate paths. Policy v3 prospectively classifies mandatory per-run labels as provenance identity: presence, syntax, uniqueness, and expected per-run values are gated, while cross-run equality is prohibited.
freeze_rule: Policy v3, comparator v3, producer catalogue v3, the closed QoR schema, ODB semantic exporter, immutable-input manifest, command manifest, compatibility adapter, and runner are hashed and made read-only before either run 5 or run 6 directory is created.

required: OCI index, linux/amd64 manifest, and OCI configuration/ImageID as separate identities
ORFS commit, tree, recursive submodules, and reconciled 169-file execution subset
GCD RTL, configuration, SDC, platform scripts, and SKY130HD collateral
OpenROAD, Yosys, KLayout, make, and Python executables and versions
runner, environment variables, thread count, and official make command
policy v3, comparator v3, ODB semantic exporter, canonicalizers, compatibility adapter, and command manifest

field_class_rules.SCIENTIFIC_TOLERANCED: The frozen field-specific absolute tolerance is applied.
field_class_rules.PROVENANCE_IDENTITY: Presence, producer, syntax, uniqueness, and expected per-run identity are gated; cross-run equality is not required unless explicitly declared.
field_class_rules.RUNTIME_RESOURCE_OBSERVATION: The raw value and hash are retained but cross-run equality is not gated.

canonicalization.absolute_run_roots: replace only recognized Gate 03E/03E-R/03E-S run roots with the frozen token
canonicalization.run_metadata: producer-catalogue classification; provenance/runtime fields are validated individually rather than equality-gated
canonicalization.netlist: structural JSON emitted by the exact-hashed pinned Yosys plus exact parsed mapped-master histogram
canonicalization.def: conservative complete token stream with no scientific-field removal
canonicalization.sdc: conservative complete token stream with no constraint removal
canonicalization.spef: conservative complete token stream with only the SPEF DATE record replaced
canonicalization.klayout_lyt: XML C14N after replacing only a recognized run-root prefix inside reader-options/lefdef/lef-files
canonicalization.odb: exact raw SHA-256 is recorded as the stronger observation; a mismatch requires equality of complete pre-frozen semantic exports covering every required category

failure_conditions: policy, catalogue, schema, comparator, exporter, runner, compatibility adapter, or immutable-input hash mismatch
OCI index, manifest, and configuration identities are missing, conflated, or mismatched
missing, malformed, duplicated, equal, or unexpected run labels
missing or additional artifact or metric
technology XML mismatch outside the one predeclared run-root substitution
ODB raw mismatch without a complete equal semantic export
unparsed ODB object category or incomplete semantic export
historical evidence or prior external run-tree change
